capabilities: Preview notes live as WeChat Official Account articles
Convert note headings into Xiaohongshu image cards and export them as PNGs
Sync notes to Feishu cloud documents
Track per-note publish status across platforms in a dashboard
Polish layout and titles with an AI provider using your own API key
disambiguation: Not a general content editing studio; it converts and publishes notes to specific Chinese platforms.
extras: Desktop only since 3.12.0. Xiaohongshu/X publishing is freemium: 3 free publishes/day, paid Pro/Max tiers sold on Afdian; the Crosspost extension is not yet publicly released. Additional guides live in docs/guides/. Includes a reference proxy server for WeChat's IP-whitelist requirement.
intentEvidence: Built on obsidian-wechat-converter by DavidLam and a TypeScript port of the note-to-red rendering engine by Yeban
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into ready-to-publish content for Chinese platforms like WeChat or Xiaohongshu, forcing manual reformatting and image handling.

relations.evidence: a TypeScript port of the note-to-red rendering engine by Yeban
requires the companion browser extension Crosspost, which is distributed separately

requires.name: WeChat Official Account AppID/Secret and self-hosted API proxy
AI provider API key for layout and title polish
Crosspost browser extension for Xiaohongshu/X draft publishing
Pro/Max license for more than the free 3 publishes/day quota

summary: Publishing converter that renders notes as WeChat Official Account articles, Xiaohongshu image cards, or Feishu docs, with live preview and draft publishing.
